conditions: Free to launch, but requires a VERIFIED Peerlist profile — identity verification via government-issued ID or workplace verification
Only individual profiles (valid name + profile picture) may launch — company/non-personal profiles are disallowed
The project added to your profile must reach 100% completion status before it is eligible
requirements: Launchable: coding projects (dev tools, extensions, libraries), design projects, digital products (ebooks, Notion templates, UI kits), etc.
Not launchable: unsafe products, copies/ripoffs, products you don't own, NSFW/gambling/betting — violations can suspend the profile
Launch window opens Mondays; each launch runs for a week with upvotes/ratings/comments
preparation: A personal account with first name, last name, username, 120-character bio, and profile picture
Identity verification (government ID or workplace) completed in advance

Project added under profile Work tab with ALL fields: name (max 45 chars), tagline (max 60), up to 3 categories, up to 10 tech tags, logo (500x500, ≤15MB), 1–4 screenshots (1200x630, ≤15MB each), description (≤5k chars), valid demo link
An engaged network beforehand — upvotes from active streak-holding users count more
workflow: Complete the profile, then get verified (ID or workplace)
Add the project under your profile's Work tab and reach 100% completion
On a Monday launch window, click 'Launch →', select the eligible project, and confirm
Engage in comments through the launch week; ranking is upvote/comment driven
watchFor: The identity-verification gate is the hard wall — an agent cannot complete government-ID verification; a human owner must do it
Incomplete projects fail at launch time — check 100% completion before Monday
Launch cadence is weekly; relaunches are allowed for new versions (more flexible than Product Hunt's cooldown, per third-party guides)
Peerlist skews to career/builder audience — good credibility, modest buyer intent
countsAsLive: Project appears in the current week's Launchpad cohort (/launchpad/<year>/week/<nn>) with upvotes, ratings and comments enabled
unknowns: Current weekly slot caps or competition level
Whether dofollow links are included on launched project pages
